QuestInfo.name: [Star Force] Starstruck Dark Wyverns
QuestInfo.0: #p2081007# heard your explanation about the falling star and let out a big sigh. Talk to him. \r\n
QuestInfo.1: #p2081007# says there is nothing that can be done about the Wyverns' attacks at this point. He is too weak to handle them. Defeat some #o8150303# monsters for him. \r\n
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated the corrupted #o8150303# monsters for #p2081007#. He thanked you for your work... repeatedly.\r\n

0.0: There is no hope. I will never finish my mission, let alone survive long enough to return home. But... with your help... Yes, you are a ray of light! Will you aid a knight in need?\r\n

yes.0: If you get rid of some #r#o8150303##k monsters, I know I can complete my mission!\r\n

no.0: It took a lot of courage for me to ask for help. I think it's only fair for you to accept. \r\n

1.0: Are those #r#o8150303##k monsters gone? Are you my knight in shining armor? Metaphorically, I mean. I'm the real knight.

yes.0: Wonderful! They'll leave me alone while I sit here waiting for the other knights to come find me!
